resourceSystem.name: Domain Soul Pool (DSP)
resourceSystem.description: A shared global resource pool ranging from 0-100 that fuels all spellcasting.

crimson.description: Crimson Sap adds +5 DSP to all spell costs

silver.description: Silver Sap subtracts -5 DSP from all spell costs

blue.description: Blue Sap has no DSP cost modifier

spells.name: Soul Shield
spells.description: Channel soul energy to reinforce your defenses, granting +2 Guard and +2 Evasion for 2 turns.

spells.name: Verdant Grasp
spells.description: Thorny vines erupt from the ground to ensnare a single enemy, rooting them in place for 1 turn.

spells.name: Bloom Step
spells.description: Dissolve into a burst of petals and teleport up to 3 tiles away.

spells.name: Thorn Volley
spells.description: Launch a volley of razor-sharp thorns at a single target, dealing 1d8 nature damage.

spells.name: Spore Cloud
spells.description: Release a noxious cloud of spores at a ground location, poisoning all enemies in a 2-tile radius for 1d4 damage per turn over 3 turns.

spells.name: Shield Bash
spells.description: Slam your shield into an enemy, dealing 1d6 physical damage and stunning them for 1 turn.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.description: Meld into shadow and reappear directly behind an enemy, dealing 1d6 backstab damage with positional advantage.

spells.name: Healing Bloom
spells.description: Channel nature's restorative energy to heal an ally for 2d6 HP.

spells.name: Aimed Shot
spells.description: Carefully aim and loose an arrow at a distant target for 1d10 ranged damage. Gains +2 to hit when firing from high ground.

spells.name: Fungal Burst
spells.description: Detonate a cluster of volatile fungi in a 2-tile radius, dealing 1d6 nature damage and slowing all affected enemies.

spells.name: Bark Armor
spells.description: Encase yourself in thick layers of enchanted bark, gaining +3 Guard for 3 turns.

spells.name: Azure Bolt
spells.description: A bolt of pure azure energy strikes a single target, dealing 1d8 arcane damage. Amplified during the Blue Sap phase.

spells.name: Burn Magic
spells.description: Sear an enemy with raw arcane force, dealing 2d6 arcane damage and removing 1 magical buff from the target.

spells.name: Root Sentinel
spells.description: Summon a wall of massive roots 3 tiles wide that blocks enemy movement for 3 turns.

spells.name: Venom Blade
spells.description: Coat your blade in lethal venom and strike for 2d8 shadow damage, applying a stacking poison that intensifies each turn.

spells.name: Ancestor's Whisper
spells.description: Commune with ancestral spirits to bless an ally, granting +2 to all rolls for 3 turns.

spells.name: Shadow Step Strike
spells.description: Teleport through shadow to strike an enemy for 2d8 shadow damage. Requires the caster to be in stealth.

spells.name: Nature Ward
spells.description: Emit a wave of healing energy, restoring 1d8 HP to all allies within range.

spells.name: Beast Companion Attack
spells.description: Command your beast companion to attack an enemy, dealing 2d6 nature damage.

spells.name: Entangling Spores
spells.description: Release a cloud of entangling spores that root all enemies in a 3-tile area and deal 1d4 nature damage per turn.

spells.name: Guardian Stance
spells.description: Adopt a protective stance, gaining +5 Guard and intercepting all attacks targeting adjacent allies for 2 turns.

spells.name: Piercing Arrow
spells.description: Loose an armor-piercing arrow that deals 2d10 damage and ignores 50% of the target's armor.

spells.name: Decay Aura
spells.description: Emanate a corrosive aura of decay that deals 1d4 damage per turn to all enemies within a 2-tile radius for 3 turns. Requires concentration.

spells.name: Silver Sight
spells.description: Attune your senses to the Silver Sap, revealing all hidden enemies and traps within a 6-tile radius.

spells.name: Crimson Surge
spells.description: Unleash a violent wave of crimson flame dealing 2d10 fire damage with a chance to inflict Bleeding. Amplified during the Crimson Sap phase.

spells.name: Sap Surge
spells.description: Detonate concentrated nature energy in a 3-tile radius, dealing 3d8 nature damage to enemies and healing allies within the area for 2d6 HP.

spells.name: Hollow Strike
spells.description: Channel void energy into a single devastating strike that deals 3d10 damage and completely destroys the target's Guard.

spells.name: Verdant Nexus
spells.description: Become a nexus of verdant energy, creating a regeneration zone that heals all allies within range for 2d6 HP per turn. Requires concentration.

spells.name: Decay Mastery
spells.description: Unleash mastery over entropy in a 4-tile area, dealing 2d8 damage to all enemies and spreading all existing debuffs to every target hit.

spells.name: Shadow Dance
spells.description: Become one with shadow, performing 3 rapid teleport-attacks against enemies in range, dealing 2d6 shadow damage with each strike.

spells.name: Storm of Arrows
spells.description: Loose a devastating rain of arrows over a 3-tile area, dealing 3d8 physical damage to all enemies caught in the barrage.

spells.name: Living Fortress
spells.description: Encase yourself in a living fortress of ancient bark and iron roots, gaining +20 Guard and reflecting 50% of incoming damage back to attackers for 3 turns.

spells.name: Radiant Burst
spells.description: An explosion of radiant light erupts in a 3-tile area, dealing 3d10 radiant damage to all enemies caught in the blast.

spells.name: Temporal Anchor
spells.description: Manipulate time to rewind a target to its position and HP from 2 turns ago.

spells.name: Necromancy: Raise Dead
spells.description: Perform a forbidden necromantic ritual to raise a defeated enemy as a temporary ally for the remainder of combat. The risen creature has 50% of its original HP and deals half damage. Inflicts +50% criminality on the caster.

spells.name: Soul Extraction
spells.description: Extract the soul from a low-HP enemy, instantly killing them and stealing their essence to permanently gain +1 to a chosen attribute. Inflicts +30% criminality on the caster.

spells.name: Abyss Pact
spells.description: Open a pact with the Abyss, granting massive power at a terrible cost. All damage and healing is doubled for 5 turns, but the caster becomes permanently corrupted. Costs no DSP.

spells.name: Verdant Bloom
spells.description: Burst of living pollen in a small radius; light nature damage and softens targets for follow-up strikes.

spells.name: Shadow Strike
spells.description: A quick blade of umbra; staple melee attack for beasts and stalkers.

spells.name: Crimson Flare
spells.description: A focused flare of hostile light; weaker cousin to Crimson Surge for imps and wardens.

spells.name: Nature Heal
spells.description: Simple mend used by corrupted flora and minor spirits.

spells.name: Arcane Shield
spells.description: Weave a barrier of ordered magic; golems and knights use it to blunt incoming harm.

spells.name: Temporal Bolt
spells.description: A time-tangled bolt that staggers the target briefly.

spells.name: Flame Dash
spells.description: Surge forward in a burning line, singeing those in the path.

spells.name: Soul Drain
spells.description: Siphon a thread of life force; sap ghost signature move.

spells.name: Whisper of Guidance
spells.description: A faint ancestral murmur that steadies an ally's next action.

spells.name: Root Barrier
spells.description: Thick roots knit a personal bulwark; sentinel spawn defensive shell.

spells.name: Thorn Reflect
spells.description: Wrap yourself in a mantle of razor thorns. For 3 turns, any enemy that strikes you in melee takes 50% of the damage they dealt, reflected as verdant piercing.
spells.lore: Ironbark veterans learned early that standing firm was not enough — the forest itself had to bite back.

spells.name: Grove Mend
spells.description: Channel the regenerative pulse of an ancient grove to immediately restore 2d10 HP to a single ally within medium range.
spells.lore: The grove remembers every wound. The Bloomguard merely asks it to forget.

spells.name: Ironbark Wall
spells.description: Raise a living wall of fused ironbark trunks 3 tiles wide at a target location. Blocks all movement and ranged fire for 4 turns. Allies can see through; enemies cannot.
spells.lore: Where the old forest wills itself, no army passes.

spells.name: Verdant Aegis
spells.description: Envelop a willing ally in a luminous shell of woven bark and living vines. Grants +8 Guard and +4 Evasion for 3 turns.
spells.lore: The Bloomguard's greatest gift is not their own survival — it is ensuring another's.

spells.name: Sap Pulse
spells.description: Release a shockwave of pressurised verdant sap from your body. Deals 2d6 verdant damage to all enemies within 3 tiles and slows them by 30% for 2 turns.
spells.lore: Living sap under pressure is more dangerous than any blade.

spells.name: Canopy Shield
spells.description: Summon an overhead canopy of interlocked branches that provides 25% damage reduction to all allies beneath it for 3 turns. Requires concentration.
spells.lore: The oldest trees learned to shelter each other long before the Hollowing came.

spells.name: Warden's Challenge
spells.description: Emit a thunderous war-bellow infused with grove-energy. All enemies within 3 tiles are forced to target you on their next action and are slowed by 20% for 2 turns.
spells.lore: The forest does not ask you to face it. It commands.

spells.name: Bloom Resurrection
spells.description: Channel the full restorative power of the grove to revive a fallen ally at 50% of their maximum HP. Usable once per combat encounter.
spells.lore: The grove does not mourn its fallen. It remembers, and it calls them back.

spells.name: Rooted Fortitude
spells.description: Plant your feet and draw strength from the earth. You become immune to forced movement and gain +5 Guard for 2 turns, but cannot move voluntarily.
spells.lore: A tree gains its power not by moving, but by refusing to.

spells.name: Nettle Trap
spells.description: Plant a near-invisible nettle trap on the ground. When triggered, it roots the victim for 2 turns and inflicts bleeding for 1d4 per turn over 2 turns.
spells.lore: The Thornbinder never fights the enemy at the enemy's choosing.

spells.name: Poison Cloud
spells.description: Hurl a flask of distilled thornvenom that bursts into a lingering cloud in a 2-tile radius. Any creature that enters the cloud takes 1d6 poison damage per turn for 4 turns.
spells.lore: A Thornbinder's greatest tools are patience and chemistry.

spells.name: Hemorrhage
spells.description: Drive a barbed blade into a vulnerable joint, dealing 1d8+3 physical damage and causing catastrophic bleeding for 1d6 per turn over 5 turns.
spells.lore: The wound the eye cannot see is the one that kills.

spells.name: Thornweb
spells.description: Launch a tangled mesh of venomous thorns that spreads across a small area, rooting all enemies within 2 tiles for 3 turns and poisoning them for 1d4 per turn.
spells.lore: Even the duskwood's most tangled corners were schoolrooms for the Thornbinder enclave.

spells.name: Poison Caltrops
spells.description: Scatter a spread of thorn-tipped iron caltrops across a 2-tile area. Enemies that move through the zone take 1d4 damage, are slowed by 40%, and poisoned for 2 turns.
spells.lore: The first lesson every Duskwood child learns: watch where you step.

spells.name: Garrote
spells.description: Wrap a razor-vine cord around an enemy's throat from behind, dealing 2d6 physical damage, silencing all spellcasting for 3 turns, and causing 1d4 bleed per turn. Requires positioning behind the target.
spells.lore: Silence is its own kind of power.

spells.name: Debilitate
spells.description: Drive a toxin-laden thorn into an enemy's limb, dealing 1d6 verdant damage and reducing both Might and Agility by 3 for 3 turns.
spells.lore: A wounded limb cannot swing a sword, however fierce the will behind it.

spells.name: Shadow Snare
spells.description: Send a tendril of pure void energy that wraps an enemy in shadow. The target is stunned and silenced for 2 turns, completely unable to act or cast.
spells.lore: The Abyss has its own roots. The Thornbinder learned to plant them.

spells.name: Crystal Lance
spells.description: Conjure a razor-sharp lance of crystallised arcane energy and hurl it at a distant target. Deals 3d8+4 magical damage and pierces through, potentially striking enemies behind.
spells.lore: The Verdance's silver sap, shaped by pure will into a weapon of crystalline perfection.

spells.name: Rift Channel
spells.description: Open a sustained rift between planes and channel its destructive energy into a beam. Deals 2d10 void damage per turn for up to 3 turns. Each turn's damage increases by 1d6 if the rift remains stable.
spells.lore: Where the Verdance thins, the Mystic reaches through.

spells.name: Insight Surge
spells.description: Flood your mind with a surge of arcane clarity. Gain +4 Insight and increase all spell damage by 20% for 3 turns.
spells.lore: The Mystic does not learn spells. They become them.

spells.name: Arcane Rift
spells.description: Tear a hole in local reality at a target point. Deals 4d6 magical damage to all in a 2-tile radius, removes 2 buffs from each target, and knocks enemies back 2 tiles.
spells.lore: Reality is a suggestion the Emerald Mystic politely declines.

spells.name: Crystal Construct
spells.description: Shape crystallised arcane energy into a golem that fights under your command. The construct has 40 HP, deals 2d8 on melee attack, and explodes for 3d6 AoE damage when destroyed.
spells.lore: The Mystics of the Silver Reach knew that creation was as powerful as destruction.

spells.name: Mana Siphon
spells.description: Drain magical energy from an enemy, dealing 2d6 damage and restoring 15 SAP to yourself. If the target is a spellcaster, the SAP restored is doubled.
spells.lore: Knowledge is power. So is everyone else's power.

spells.name: Prismatic Burst
spells.description: Release all arcane potential in a blinding multi-spectral explosion around you. Deals 3d10 magical damage to all enemies within 4 tiles and applies 3 random debuffs to each target.
spells.lore: When the Mystic shatters the light, every shard is a different kind of ruin.

spells.name: Verdant Mirror
spells.description: Weave a sheet of verdant-infused glass around yourself. For 2 turns, any single-target spell aimed at you is reflected back at its caster.
spells.lore: The Verdance sees all. The Mystic teaches it to speak back.

spells.name: Knowledge Drain
spells.description: Extract arcane wisdom from an enemy's mind, dealing 1d6 void damage, reducing their Insight by 4 for 3 turns, and increasing their spell costs by 5 SAP.
spells.lore: What the Mystic learns, the enemy forgets.

spells.name: Wind Dash
spells.description: Burst forward with the speed of a rushing gale, dashing to a target location and dealing 1d6 physical damage to any enemy you pass through. Grants +20% Evasion for 2 turns afterward.
spells.lore: The wilds taught the Ranger one thing above all: if you stop moving, you die.

spells.name: Beast Bond
spells.description: Call a bonded wildkin beast companion to your side. The beast has 35 HP, attacks for 2d6 on your command, and provides flanking bonuses when adjacent to your targets.
spells.lore: The Verdance gifted the Ranger not with magic, but with kin.

spells.name: Camouflage
spells.description: Blend your body and gear with the natural environment, entering deep stealth for up to 4 turns. Unlike standard stealth, Camouflage persists through slow movement.
spells.lore: The forest hides what it loves. The Ranger learned to ask nicely.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Brand a target with a hunter's mark, causing them to take 15% increased damage from all sources for 5 turns. The mark also reveals the target if it attempts to become invisible.
spells.lore: When a Ranger marks prey, the hunt is already over.

spells.name: Disengage
spells.description: Leap backward up to 4 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. If used after an attack this turn, cooldown is reduced by 1.
spells.lore: Close the distance, strike, vanish. Repeat until the enemy stops moving.

spells.name: Volley Rain
spells.description: Loose a sustained volley of arrows in a concentrated zone for 2 turns, dealing 2d8 physical damage per turn to all enemies in the area and slowing them by 25%.
spells.lore: Quantity has a quality all its own.

spells.name: Scout Sense
spells.description: Expand your wildkin senses to their limit, revealing the exact position of all enemies and hidden traps within 8 tiles for 4 turns.
spells.lore: The Verdance whispers everything to those who remember how to listen.

spells.name: Crippling Shot
spells.description: Target the legs with a precise shot, dealing 2d6+2 physical damage and halving movement speed while reducing Agility by 2 for 3 turns.
spells.lore: You do not need to outrun prey you have already crippled.

spells.name: Mushroom Ring
spells.description: Grow a ring of volatile mushrooms in a 2-tile radius around a target point. Any enemy that enters or ends their turn inside the ring takes 1d6 verdant damage and is poisoned for 1 turn.
spells.lore: In the deep groves, the fungal circles were sacred. To the Sporecaller, they are weapons.

spells.name: Rot Bloom
spells.description: Detonate every active poison on a single target in a necrotic bloom. Deals 2d8 damage plus 1d6 for each stack of poison currently on the target. Poisons are consumed.
spells.lore: Patience cultivated. Harvest taken.

spells.name: Spore Sentinel
spells.description: Grow a massive Spore Walker from concentrated fungal matter. The creature has 45 HP, attacks for 2d6 per turn, and releases a small spore cloud on death that poisons nearby enemies for 3 turns.
spells.lore: From decay comes the most persistent of defenders.

spells.name: Mind Spores
spells.description: Infect a target's mind with hallucinogenic spores. For 3 turns, the victim attacks a random target (ally or enemy) each turn and cannot use spells.
spells.lore: The mushroom's truest power was never poison. It was suggestion.

spells.name: Fungal Network
spells.description: Weave an underground fungal network connecting all allies within 6 tiles. For 5 turns, the network shares scouting vision and transfers 1d4 HP between linked members at the start of each turn.
spells.lore: The mycelium remembers everything beneath the soil. The Sporecaller learned to walk the memory.

spells.name: Toxic Bloom
spells.description: Erupt a concentrated bloom of toxic spores in a 2-tile area, dealing 3d6 verdant damage and applying a virulent poison that deals 2d4 per turn for 3 turns to all affected.
spells.lore: The most dangerous blooms are the ones you cannot see coming.

spells.name: Decay Embrace
spells.description: Latch a decay channel onto a single target, dealing 1d8 verdant damage per turn for 4 turns. Each passing turn adds an additional stack of Rot, permanently reducing the target's maximum HP by 2 until healed.
spells.lore: The forest does not attack. It simply takes back what was always its own.

spells.name: Sporequake
spells.description: Trigger an underground fungal network eruption, causing a massive spore-quake. Deals 4d8 verdant damage to all enemies in a 4-tile radius, knocks them prone for 1 turn, and leaves a toxic spore field for 3 turns.
spells.lore: When the Sporecaller stamps their staff, the ground remembers it has roots.

spells.name: Verdant Heal
spells.description: Channel the restorative essence of the Verdance to mend an ally's wounds, restoring 2d6 HP.
spells.lore: The Emerald Mystic draws not from arcane theory, but from the living pulse of the forest itself.

spells.name: Wind Arrow
spells.description: Loose an arrow imbued with swirling wind energy, striking a distant target for 1d8 wind damage.
spells.lore: The Wildkin Ranger learns to let the wind carry their will before they ever learn to speak.

spells.name: Root Snare
spells.description: Conjure grasping roots from the earth to bind an enemy in place, dealing 1d4 nature damage and rooting them for 2 turns.
spells.lore: The Sporecaller's first lesson: the forest floor is never still, only patient.

spells.name: Veil Mend
spells.description: Draw upon the hidden power of the Veilkeepers to mend grievous wounds, restoring 3d6 HP to a single ally.
spells.lore: The Veil remembers wholeness. The mender merely reminds the body.

spells.name: Nature's Embrace
spells.description: Wrap an ally in the living embrace of the Verdance, restoring 4d6 HP as vines and blossoms knit their wounds shut.
spells.lore: The forest does not heal. It grows over what was broken, making it stronger.

spells.name: Cascade Heal
spells.description: Unleash a cascading wave of restorative water that washes over all allies in a wide area, healing each for 2d8 HP.
spells.lore: Water remembers the shape of life. It pours itself into every wound it finds.

spells.name: Ancient Ward
spells.description: Invoke the protective wards of the ancients, surrounding yourself in a holy barrier that absorbs incoming damage for 3 turns.
spells.lore: The first Veilkeepers did not fight. They endured, and the world broke against them.

spells.name: Fungal Shield
spells.description: Grow a dense layer of hardened fungal plates over your body, granting a protective guard effect for 3 turns.
spells.lore: The deepest fungi survive by turning soft tissue to stone. The Sporecaller borrows the trick.

spells.name: Nexus Harmony
spells.description: Channel the full harmonic resonance of the Nexus itself, unleashing a massive wave of holy energy that restores 6d8 HP to all allies in a wide area.
spells.lore: When the Nexus sings, even the dying remember what it means to live.

spells.name: Veil Sight
spells.description: Peer through the Veil to reveal all hidden enemies within range, stripping away invisibility and exposing ambushes.
spells.lore: The Veil hides nothing from those who know where to look.

spells.name: Worldroot Blessing
spells.description: Invoke the blessing of the Worldroot, the great tree at the heart of the Verdance, granting a powerful blessed aura to an ally for 5 turns.
spells.lore: The Worldroot's roots touch every corner of the realm. Its blessing is felt by all who stand in its light.

spells.name: Veil-Piercing Sight
spells.description: Focus your sight beyond the Veil with enhanced clarity, revealing all hidden enemies and traps within an extended range of 12 tiles.
spells.lore: Where Veil Sight whispers, Veil-Piercing Sight screams. Nothing hides from the piercing gaze.
